data.name: Powerful Smash
data.description: As a standard action, the shaman can attack with unarmed strikes as if she had the Improved Unarmed Strike feat. If the shaman hits a creature in this way, that creature must succeed at a Fortitude save (DC %1) or be dazed for 1 round. The shaman can use this ability %2 times per day.|10+ShamanLVL/2+CHA|3+CHA
